// diagnostic

E0400

This member cannot be stored in a named marker group.

What

This member cannot be stored in a named marker group.

Why

A group contains only active, fixed marker applications; gates, refusals and other groups must not be hidden in it.

Fix

Remove this member from the group and write gates or refusals explicitly at each use site.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0400: tests/ui/marker_group_forbidden.stderr.
